name: dori-superagent
description: A proactive multi-session coding-agent harness in ~1,600 lines, running on herdr + omo.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p skills/dori-mode/scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.json
scripts.ci: bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run knip && bun run lint:loc && bun run test:tmp
scripts.build:sheets: rm -rf assets/board/sheets && bun build web/sheets.ts --outdir assets/board/sheets --target browser --format esm --splitting --minify --entry-naming '[name].[ext]' --chunk-naming 'chunk-[hash].[ext]' --define 'process.env.NODE_ENV="production"'
